sources.title: Discontinuities and hysteresis in quantized average consensus
sources.enterprise_use: Provides direct prior art for introducing a hysteretic quantizer to cope with unwanted chattering in a quantized hybrid-control setting. E002 uses it to mark hysteretic quantization and chatter suppression as established neighboring engineering, not as an Enterprise Math invention.
sources.not_claimed: Hysteretic quantizers, hybrid hysteresis, and their use against chattering are established prior work and are not claimed as Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: Stability of quantized time-delay nonlinear systems: A Lyapunov-Krasowskii-functional approach
sources.enterprise_use: Provides established quantized-control work in which hysteresis is incorporated in the quantizer/controller to prevent chattering. E002 treats this as a close engineering neighbor while testing a different foundational interpretation of the resolution coordinate.
sources.not_claimed: Quantized feedback, hysteresis for chattering prevention, and the cited stability analysis are prior work and are not Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: Primary frequency regulation in power grids with on-off loads: chattering, limit cycles and convergence to optimality
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a control-engineering benchmark showing that hysteretic on-off policies can remove chattering while nontrivial limit-cycle behavior may remain. E002 uses this as a prior-art boundary for distinguishing chatter suppression from convergence.
sources.not_claimed: The analysis of hysteretic on-off loads, chattering avoidance, limit cycles, or power-grid convergence in this work is not claimed by Enterprise Math.
